title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Uniqueness of OLS Solution
text: In the context of linear regression, the Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) solution is unique if the matrix of features (X) is full rank, meaning all columns are linearly independent.

title: Effect of L1 Regularization on Uniqueness
text: L1 regularization can lead to a unique solution even when the feature matrix is not full rank, as it introduces a penalty that can help in selecting a unique set of coefficients.

title: Analyzing the Given Statement
